decision: Retain the incumbent. No added diagnosis in the untouched reserve.

arms.a: original own pawn departure and same-file heavy-piece check
arms.b: also allows capture of a second original shield pawn
arms.c: also requires tactical proof for a corroborated costly exchange to add a tactical diagnosis
arms.d: tests the relevant shield pawn or whether the king leaves the file in the better lines

sampling: OTB, one board per game in each 18-game cohort. The initial cohort was unexposed to A-C and served as development for D. Both references were frozen before replay output. Historical cases are development.
evaluation: Actual played-move diagnosis, one engine-assisted reviewer. Cases with uncertain reference axes are excluded from that axis score.
runtime: All arms replay identical Stockfish 19 inputs, including available shared replies. No treatment adds engine searches. Worker timings are concurrent wall measurements.

factor.description: gxf4 moves the pawn from g3 out of the king's cover. Both played lines then show Bxh3 taking the original pawn on h3. Both better lines keep both cover pawns through the comparison.
